2608.23541.title: The Interaction Tax: When Communication Erases Diversity in Multi-Agent Teams
2608.23541.paper_summary: Does multi-agent LLM interaction help or hurt? Some work reports gains from debate (Du et al., 2024), critique loops (Chen et al., 2025), and mixture-of-agents synthesis (Wang et al., 2025), while other work finds that interaction adds cost without improving quality under equal budgets (Tran & Kiela, 2026; Xu et al., 2026; Jarrett et al., 2025), or that independent sampling already captures multi-agent gains (Li et al., 2024). We argue this contradiction partly reflects a missing distinction, because not all multi-agent communication is equal. Different model families find structurally different solutions, but when agents read each other's complete outputs, their proposals converge within one round, erasing the diversity that motivates using multiple models. We call this the interaction tax. We test 11 verifier-scored optimization tasks under matched budgets and find that full-solution interaction is a weak default. Independent proposal generation avoids this collapse. Full-solution interaction mainly makes agents stay close to the first solution they see instead of trying different approaches, and critique helps only if the violated rule is easy for the LLM to find and fix. These results suggest that multi-agent performance depends less on the number of agents than on the information they exchange, and interaction helps only when agents share the right information at the right time.
2608.23541.paper_summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 互動是有幫助還是有害？一些研究報告了辯論（Du et al., 2024）、批評迴圈（Chen et al., 2025）和混合代理合成（Wang et al., 2025）的收益，而其他研究則發現，在相同預算下，互動增加了成本卻未改善質量（Tran & Kiela, 2026；Xu et al., 2026；Jarrett et al., 2025），或是獨立取樣已經捕捉到了多代理的收益（Li et al., 2024）。我們認為這一矛盾部分反映了一個缺失的區分，因為並非所有的多代理通信都是平等的。不同的模型家族找到結構上不同的解決方案，但當代理閱讀彼此的完整輸出時，他們的提案在一輪內會收斂，抹去了使用多個模型的多樣性。我們稱之為互動稅。我們在匹配預算下測試了 11 個驗證者評分的優化任務，發現全解互動是一個弱的默認選擇。獨立提案生成避免了這種崩潰。全解互動主要使代理保持在他們看到的第一個解決方案附近，而不是嘗試不同的方法，並且只有當違反的規則對 LLM 來說容易被找到和修正時，批評才有幫助。這些結果表明，多代理的表現與代理的數量關係不大，而是與他們交換的信息有關，互動只有在代理在合適的時間分享正確的信息時才有幫助。
